Thirteenth pilot, most structurally complex to date: Model mModel[5] array member (first array-typed member in this series) and a heap-allocated auxiliary dCcPos_c linked list unrelated to the class's own storage. InitResources, CleanupResources, Render and OnPendingDestroy are real daTree_c:: methods; Behavior and Tree_Spawn stay hand-written free functions under their own ROM names (daObjPathLift_c/#1719 precedent) because their bodies never reference a named daTree_c member, and Tree_Spawn is unmangled in the ROM.

AN EARLIER REVISION OF THIS ENTRY CLAIMED THE OPPOSITE AND WAS WRONG. It recorded that the merged TU was NOT the key-function TU and needed neither compiler_only_output nor externalized_output, both left empty. That was an artifact of how the TU was written, not a fact about the class: InitResources -- the class's FIRST DECLARED virtual, which is what the key-function rule selects, not the first slot -- was a hand-mangled extern "C" free function, so no TU anywhere defined the key function and mwccarm emitted no RTTI group at all. The eight legacy per-function objects between them still PROVED _ZTV4Tree against the ROM, so promoting to a shimmed TU that proved nothing LOWERED the tree-wide romdata-verified count by one, and the merge validator rejected it. Writing InitResources as a real member and the destructor inline in include/daTree_c.h emits the complete group and the retail D1/D0 pair in ROM order; all nine records are deadstrip-data rows below with a canonical module and address, and romdata_check word-compares each against the cartridge. Tree_Spawn's vtable-pointer store now carries the usual +8 Itanium-preamble addend (&_ZTV8daTree_c[2]), like every dActor_c-derived pilot that became its class's key-function TU.

THE NAMING BOUNDARY IS CLOSED. The class was coined `Tree`. MEASURED in extracted/overlays/overlay_0002.bin (ov002 base 0x020ad660, the `.text start:` on line 1 of config/arm9/overlays/ov002/delinks.txt): the vtable object's preamble at 0x0210abf8 is [offset-to-top 0, 0x0210abd0], and _ZTI8daTree_c at 0x0210abd0 reads [0x0209a764, 0x0210abc4, 0x0208e390] -- _ZTVN3abi20__si_class_type_infoE (config/arm9/symbols.txt), a typeinfo name at 0x0210abc4 whose bytes are the string "8daTree_c", and _ZTI8dActor_c, so the cartridge states the direct base too. config/arm9/overlays/ov002/symbols.txt already carried _ZTS8daTree_c and _ZTI8daTree_c at those addresses while the class was still spelled `Tree`.

Promoted filename uses the snake_case scheme in notes/tu-naming-and-swallowers.md sec 1 (tools/tu_names.py): daTree_c -> d_a_tree. The class name changed too, from the coined `Tree` to the cartridge's own `daTree_c` -- see the note above for why that rename is what makes this entry's compiler_only_output verifiable at all.
